subject: Validation cadence & initial run: StellerAI onboarding
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq@stellerai.com>; Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellerai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Validation cadence & initial run: StellerAI onboarding

Hi Tariq / Alicia —

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. To keep momentum on the onboarding acceptance path, we’ve sketched a compact validation cadence that will get us to formal sign-off by end of next week (assuming the official load passes).

Summary / asks:
- Redwood will run an instrumented official load test on Tue 2025-06-17 (window: 10:00–12:00 PT).
- Target gates for sign-off: 95th percentile latency <= 450ms at 90% CPU utilization, sustained throughput 12k tokens/sec for the steady-state profile you shared.
- StellerAI to provide a final test token set, concurrency matrix, and a confirmation of the client-side load generator IPs by Mon 2025-06-16 EOD.

Attached: stellerai-load-plan-v1.xlsx (draft test matrix, sequence lengths, and traffic shaping).

Ben — can you confirm the test harness and which model variants we should exercise (v1.2 quantized + v1.3 fp16 fallback)?

Marissa — I’ll need the monitoring dashboard link and the runbook link you’ll use for the handover.

Thanks,
Naomi
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: stellerai-load-plan-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - test matrix)

From: Tariq Hassan <tariq@stellerai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellerai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation cadence & initial run: StellerAI onboarding

Hi Naomi —

This plan looks good. Quick clarifications from our side before we lock the generator IPs on Monday:
1) Concurrency: our expected peak concurrency is 120 concurrent user sessions (roughly 300 concurrent requests when you account for streaming split). We included a concurrency-to-requests mapping in the load-plan, but confirm you can model streaming splits.
2) Tail latency: we’d like to see both p95 and p99 reported; p99 target we’d be comfortable accepting up to 900ms provided p95 is within 450ms and no error-rate drift.
3) Data privacy: we’ll send a masked token set (PII removed).

I attached a short smoke-run output from our QA that shows steady-state behavior at lower concurrency.

Best,
Tariq
Head of Engineering
StellerAI

---
Attachment: stellerai-smoke-logs.tar.gz (log bundle, truncated)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq@stellerai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-15T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation cadence & initial run: StellerAI onboarding

Tariq —

Thanks for the details, they’re helpful. Short answers:
- Yes, our runtime supports streaming splits; the load harness will reproduce the split pattern you sent in the spreadsheet.
- We’ll capture p50/p95/p99 and error-rate over the run. For the official run we’ll also enable KV-cache priming to simulate warmed deployments (that’s the main difference from your QA smoke output).
- We’ll exercise two model variants: stellerai-model-v1.2-quant (primary) and v1.3-fp16 (fallback). We’ll do a 70/30 traffic split across them during the steady-state window unless you request otherwise.

Question for you: do you need us to run the runbook with a simulated SSD saturation (we can limit IO bandwidth) to validate graceful degradation, or is that out-of-scope for this acceptance?

Notes: I’ll attach the Redwood harness configuration we’ll use in the handover message tomorrow.

- Ben
Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Tariq Hassan <tariq@stellerai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellerai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-16T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Validation cadence & initial run: StellerAI onboarding

Ben / Naomi —

We’d like to keep IO saturation testing out of scope for the official acceptance run; we’ll schedule a separate resilience window later. For this run the core acceptance criteria are pure latency/throughput and error stability.

Also: confirmed the generator IP list and test token set were uploaded to the Drive folder you shared.

We did a second smoke run after tweaking our client-side throttling; logs look stable at 80 concurrent sessions.

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

Tariq

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tariq Hassan <tariq@stellerai.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@stellerai.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final results & next steps: StellerAI official validation run (2025-06-17)

Team —

Summary of the official run (full PDF attached):
- Steady-state throughput: median across samples = 11.8k tokens/sec (target 12k). We observed a short warmup phase (first 3min) where cache priming increased tail latency.
- Latency: p95 = 420ms, p99 = 860ms (meets the p95 gate; p99 is within the previously agreed contingency threshold).
- Errors: sustained error rate during steady-state = 0.03% (all transient client 429s; no 5xx errors from runtime).
- CPU/GPU: average GPU utilization 88% during steady-state. No memory pressure events captured.

Action items / next steps:
1) StellerAI to confirm acceptance of the results if they’re comfortable with p99 = 860ms (we flagged the warmup behavior in the report and recommended a short cache-priming step for production rollout).
2) Redwood to circulate the full trace bundle and perf artifacts to your SREs (Drive link below).
3) Schedule a resilience run (IO-saturation) in Q3 — Ben to propose dates.

Links and artifacts:
- Final report (PDF): stellerai-official-run-report.pdf (attached)
- Shared artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_stellerai-onboard
- Runbook used: https://redwood-infra.playbook/runbooks/stellerai-load-run-2025-06-17

If StellerAI confirms acceptance, Marissa will open the internal onboarding close checklist and we’ll move to capacity provisioning and SLA amendment.

Thanks everyone — great collaboration this week.

Naomi
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
